voice_absent.title: Voice chat is an add-on
voice_absent.lead: Talk to a chat hands-free: DisPatch listens, works out when you have finished, and speaks the bot's reply back sentence by sentence. It all runs on this server's own processor, so nothing you say leaves the machine. Voice chat is a separate package, DisPatch Voice (MIT), so DisPatch itself stays small and installs without any speech software.

voice_absent.step_models: 3. Download the speech models in Settings → Voice

voice_absent.restart_hint: Then turn voice chat on here. The page does not need a reload.

agents.reads_untrusted: This agent reads web pages, email or uploads

agents.budget_hint: Costs are estimates. A limit stops the task and tells you.
agents.publish_legend: Who can assign tasks to this agent
agents.limits_hint: Daily limits are shared by every task of an agent or a person. Figures are estimates.

agents.secrets_hint: Keys that MCP servers need. You can set or remove one here; DisPatch never shows one again.

host_notice.upload_title: Files are stored on the host computer
host_notice.upload_body: Files you send are saved on the computer that runs DisPatch, not on this device. Other people who use DisPatch here, and anyone with access to that computer, may be able to open them.
host_notice.fileserver_title: Files stored on the host computer
host_notice.fileserver_body: Files here are saved on the computer that runs DisPatch. Everyone who can open the File Server sees them, and so can anyone with access to that computer.
host_notice.images_title: Images stored on the host computer
host_notice.images_body: Pictures you add here are saved on the computer that runs DisPatch, not on this device. Anyone with access to that computer can open them, and everyone who sees this character sees its pictures.
host_notice.chats_title: Chats are stored on the host computer
host_notice.chats_body: Every chat is saved on the computer that runs DisPatch, not on this device. Chats are not private and not end-to-end encrypted. A chat belongs to its character, not to one person: everyone who can use a character can open its chats, and the Owner and Admins can use every character, so they can read every chat, Restricted profiles' chats included. Anyone with access to that computer, its files or its backups can read them too.
host_notice.chats_restricted_title: Your chats are kept on the host computer
host_notice.chats_restricted_body: Your chats are saved on the computer that runs DisPatch. They are not secret: the grown-ups who use DisPatch here can read them.
